Step 1: Interpret date 02-05-1015 as 1015-05-02 (YYYY-MM-DD).  
Step 2: Subtract 180 days.  
Step 3: 1015 is not a leap year (divisible by 5? 1015/5=203, but leap year rule for Gregorian: divisible by 4, not by 100 unless divisible by 400; 1015 not divisible by 4).  
Step 4: Count back: from May 2, go back 30 days → April 2 (31 days in March, so 30 days back from May 2 is April 2). Actually easier:  
180 days = 6 months roughly, but exact count:  
April: 30 days → back to April 2 (30 days)  
March: 31 days → back to March 2 (61 days)  
February: 28 days (1015 not leap) → back to Feb 2 (89 days)  
January: 31 days → back to Jan 2 (120 days)  
December 1014: 31 days → back to Dec 2, 1014 (151 days)  
November 1014: 30 days → back to Nov 2, 1014 (181 days) → overshot by 1 day, so add 1 day back: Nov 3, 1014.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1014-11-03
